QuestInfo.name: End of Special Training
QuestInfo.0: Upon reaching Lv. 200, Headmaster #p2152000# of #m310000000# talks to you.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152000# wants you to come to the school. He has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152000# thanked you for your diligence during Special Training and explained that your training is over, as you have nothing left to learn. As a Resistance member and resident of the town, he would like to see you dedicate yourself to Edelstein. You received the Hero's Echo skill along with his words of appreciation.

0.1: A long time has passed since we first began our Special Training together. Thank you for your dedication and hard work.
0.2: We have one last session remaining. Please come to Edelstein. Do you remember how it was when you first started out?

1.0: You were a clueless rookie. Then, you became a student who participated in Special Training. Since then, you've proven yourself time and time again. I am proud of what you've achieved.
1.1: You no longer have anything to learn through Special Training. You've surpassed your teacher and achieved the impossible. But this isn't the end of your growth. You still have lots to learn, not from a teacher, but from the world.
1.2: Let this be a new beginning, a new chapter in your life. You can further improve yourself and become stronger until the day our town is freed. I'd like to give you a little present in wishing you good luck on your future endeavors.

yes.0: Hero's Echo... An appropriate skill for the hero who will one day free Edelstein.
